capabilities: Edit Mermaid source beside a live diagram preview in Live Preview
Resize the source and preview panes by dragging or keyboard handles
Show syntax errors in the preview and clear them after correction
Undo and redo edits using the host note history
Reset pane dimensions by double-clicking a handle
extras: Requires Obsidian desktop 1.15.0 or later; mobile support not declared. Community listing is published but automated review is still in progress. Pane dimensions are not stored in notes and reset when the view is recreated; nested or unclosed fences keep normal editing behavior.
problem: Editing Mermaid blocks in Obsidian means alternating between the code fence and the rendered diagram instead of seeing both at once.
summary: Split-pane editor that shows Mermaid source beside a live diagram preview in Live Preview mode.
